strings.name: Cynthia Breazeal
strings.summary: Cynthia Breazeal studies social robotics and human–robot interaction. Kismet explores how expressions, gaze and voice support communication. She founded and leads MIT’s Personal Robots group, directs RAISE, and serves as Dean for Digital Learning and faculty co-director of MIT for America. She co-founded Jibo and formerly held roles including Chief Scientist. Education and health are research settings; they do not establish universal learning benefits or clinical efficacy.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Birth is limited to 1967, recorded in MIT’s thesis catalog. Announcement dates, effective dates and award classes are distinguished. Jibo roles are historical; team projects are not credited to her alone.
strings.influence.rationale: Advances social robotics and human–robot interaction, exploring applications in education, communication and everyday life.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Earned an MIT Sc.D. in electrical engineering and computer science in 2000, studying Kismet’s social interaction.
strings.facts.f2.label: Research and education
strings.facts.f2.value: Leads Personal Robots and RAISE, studying human–robot interaction and advancing AI literacy.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Social interaction research
strings.highlights.h1.text: Uses Kismet to investigate how robots perceive and express social cues and interact with people.
strings.highlights.h2.title: AI literacy education
strings.highlights.h2.text: Works with colleagues across MIT on RAISE and Day of AI resources for teachers, students and adult learners.
strings.timeline.t1.title: MIT for America announced
strings.timeline.t1.text: MIT announces an initiative to broaden STEM education; she and Eric Klopfer serve as faculty co-directors.
strings.timeline.t2.title: MIT announces AAAS fellowship
strings.timeline.t2.text: MIT confirms her election to the 2024 AAAS Fellows class; this is the announcement date, not the class year.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Digital learning deanship takes effect
strings.timeline.t3.text: The January 26 appointment takes effect on this date; she continues to lead Personal Robots and RAISE.
strings.timeline.t4.title: MIT reports Day of AI plans
strings.timeline.t4.text: A post-event report presents RAISE’s planned annual school AI event and her curriculum introduction; its publication date is not the inaugural event date.
strings.timeline.t5.title: MIT introduces RAISE
strings.timeline.t5.text: MIT describes the cross-department AI education initiative she leads, serving preK–12 and workforce education.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Professorship and associate directorship take effect
strings.timeline.t6.text: Her promotion to full professor and appointment as Media Lab associate director take effect, as specified in the June 19 announcement.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Social robotics book published
strings.timeline.t7.text: MIT Press publishes the hardcover Designing Sociable Robots, using Kismet to explain a design framework; the paperback follows in 2004.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completes MIT doctorate
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completes an Sc.D. thesis on expressive human–robot interaction under Rodney Brooks.
